  intro α β f f_inv hf
  haveI : ∀ {α : Sort*}, Nonempty α → Nonempty α := by
    intro α
    intro h
    exact h
  classical
  by_cases hα : Nonempty α
  · -- Case: α is nonempty
    have h_injective : Function.Injective f := by
      intro a₁ a₂ h
      have h₁ : f_inv hα (f a₁) = a₁ := hf hα a₁
      have h₂ : f_inv hα (f a₂) = a₂ := hf hα a₂
      have h₃ : f_inv hα (f a₁) = f_inv hα (f a₂) := by rw [h]
      rw [h₁, h₂] at h₃
      exact h₃
    -- Since f is injective, we can use the standard equivalence from injective functions
    have h_main : α ≃ Set.range f := by
      apply Equiv.ofInjective f h_injective
    -- Convert the equivalence to the required form
    exact h_main.ofNatCast
  · -- Case: α is empty
    have hα' : IsEmpty α := by
      exact ⟨fun a => hα ⟨a⟩⟩
    -- When α is empty, the range of f is also empty
    have h_range_empty : Set.range f = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro y hy
      rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have h : Nonempty α := ⟨x⟩
      contradiction
    -- The equivalence between empty types is trivial
    have h_equiv : α ≃ (Set.range f : Type) := by
      have h₁ : Empty ≃ (Set.range f : Type) := by
        have h₂ : Set.range f = ∅ := h_range_empty
        have h₃ : (Set.range f : Type) = Empty := by
          simp_all [Set.ext_iff]
          <;> aesop
        rw [h₃]
        <;> simp [Equiv.refl]

        apply Equiv.empty
        <;> exact hα'

        α ≃ Empty := h₂
        _ ≃ (Set.range f : Type) := h₁
    -- Convert the equivalence to the required form
    exact h_equiv.ofNatCast
